metadata.name: scrip
metadata.description: Scrip — a rule on a wallet. Holds the rule and the receipts, never the assets.

docs: # Scrip — a rule on a wallet
THE PROGRAM IS NEVER THE VAULT. The owner's USDC and the owner's stock both sit in the
owner's own token accounts. The program holds three things: the rule the owner signed,
the receipts it writes, and — for the length of one transaction, or one open intake —
an escrow on its way to a recipient.
THE PROGRAM NEVER DECIDES HOW MUCH. The rate is the owner's. The price is Pyth's. The
route is the keeper's, bounded by the owner's tolerance. The timing is arrival. There is
no instruction here that lets anyone — keeper, payer, deployer — choose an amount.
PAUSING IS A TOKEN-PROGRAM REVOKE. The rule works through a delegate allowance the owner
approved on their own USDC account. Revoking it is an instruction on the token program,
and nothing in this program can prevent, delay or reverse it.

instructions.name: begin_sweep
docs: The first half of a sweep. Computes the slice from on-chain state and moves exactly
that much USDC to the keeper through the delegate — but ONLY after proving, through
the instructions sysvar, that a `finish_sweep` for this book and release id follows in
this same transaction. If it does not, this refuses. If it does and fails, everything
here reverts with it, including this transfer.

accounts.name: owner_asset
docs: the handler, and created there if it does not exist yet.

instructions.name: cancel_payout
docs: Take back a sponsored position nobody claimed, after thirty days.

instructions.name: claim_payout
docs: Claim a sponsored position into the claimer's own wallet. The claimer needs a Book
(the client prepends `open_book`); the fee and the rent may be paid by a relayer.

accounts.name: claimer
docs: The person taking the position. Signs, but need not hold any SOL.

accounts.name: fee_payer
docs: Pays the fee, the receipt's rent and the token account's rent. A relayer, or the
claimer themselves.

accounts.name: claim_key
docs: The claim key, for a sponsorship addressed to a link rather than an address.

instructions.name: close_book
docs: Close the book and its handle. Returns the rent and the float to the owner.

instructions.name: close_grant
docs: Close a finished grant: the escrow is empty (everything vested, or returned), and the
rent and the remaining float go back to the payer. An unsealed grant closes too, its
escrow returned to the payer.

instructions.name: disable_rule
docs: Turn the rule off. The client puts `revoke` BEFORE this instruction; the program
checks that the delegate is gone. Pausing WITHOUT this instruction is `revoke` alone,
which this program cannot see coming and cannot prevent.

instructions.name: enable_rule
docs: Turn the rule on. The client puts `approve_checked(delegate = book)` and a system
transfer of float BEFORE this instruction in the same transaction, so "on" on chain
means the delegate really is set.

instructions.name: finish_sweep
docs: The second half. Verifies what arrived against Pyth, writes the receipt, pays the
keeper from the float. Any failure here reverts the whole transaction, delegate
transfer included.

instructions.name: fund_payout
docs: Create the escrow for an intake. A Jupiter swap in the same transaction fills it.

accounts.name: recipient_book
docs: The recipient's Book: required for Settle, where the asset must match.

instructions.name: measure_receipt
docs: Record the recipient's raw balance of the asset at 7 or 30 days. Anyone may call it;
the answer comes from the recipient's own token account and nowhere else.

accounts.name: recipient_asset
docs: derivation; may not exist, which reads as a balance of zero.

instructions.name: open_book
docs: Open a book: a handle, an asset, an attestation. One per owner. The rent may be paid
by somebody else, so a claim from an empty wallet can open a book on the way.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Whoever pays the rent. The owner, or a relayer sponsoring a claim.

instructions.name: open_grant
docs: Open a grant: the escrow the stock will vest from, and the recipient's own asset
account if they have none yet. The client puts a Memo, the Jupiter route (USDC →
asset, destination = the escrow) and `seal_grant` in the same transaction.

accounts.name: recipient_asset
docs: The recipient's own account, created now by the payer so every vest is one instruction.

instructions.name: release_payout
docs: Release a settle payout: escrow → the recipient's own account, receipt, close.

instructions.name: revoke_grant
docs: Revoke a revocable grant: what had not accrued returns to the payer; what had accrued
stays claimable by `vest`, receipt and all.

instructions.name: seal_grant
docs: Seal the grant, in the same transaction as the route: the escrow holds at least the
payer's own minimum, the total is fixed, the float that pays for vest receipts and
tips is deposited, and the grant's own receipt is written.

instructions.name: set_asset
docs: Change the asset the rule buys. The watermark resets to the current balance so the
change never taxes money that already landed.

instructions.name: set_rule
docs: Change the rule, or resume it after a pause: the watermark resets to the current
balance, so money that landed while paused is not taxed retroactively. The escalation
clock restarts only if the rate or the escalation changed.

instructions.name: sync_watermark
docs: Lower the watermark to the balance after the owner spent. Anyone may call it, because
it can only ever set the watermark to the TRUE balance, and only downward: it cannot
make money that already landed taxable, only stop a spend from hiding the next arrival.
Without it, an owner who spent $700 would see nothing convert until their balance had
climbed back past the old mark. A sweep that finds nothing to sweep reverts, so the
adjustment needs a transaction of its own.

instructions.name: vest
docs: Vest what the schedule has released: escrow → the recipient's own account, with a
receipt. Anyone may call it; the caller is repaid the tip and the receipt's rent from
the grant's float. A revoked grant still vests what had accrued by the revoke.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Whoever calls it: a keeper, the recipient, the payer. Repaid from the float.

instructions.name: withdraw_float
docs: Take float back. Depositing needs no instruction: a system transfer to the Book's
address is the deposit.

errors.name: SlugInvalid
errors.msg: A handle is 3 to 24 characters of a-z and 0-9.

errors.name: AssetNotRegistered
errors.msg: That asset is not on the registry.

errors.name: TermsRequired
errors.msg: An xStocks asset needs an eligibility attestation (terms_version >= 1).

errors.name: WrongUsdcMint
errors.msg: The pay-in mint is not the one this program accepts.

errors.name: WrongUsdcDecimals
errors.msg: The pay-in mint must have six decimals.

errors.name: RateOutOfRange
errors.msg: The rate must be between 0.01% and 50%.

errors.name: EscalationOutOfRange
errors.msg: Escalation must be between 0 and 50%.

errors.name: ToleranceOutOfRange
errors.msg: The tolerance must be between 0.5% and 3%.

errors.name: RuleAlreadyEnabled
errors.msg: The rule is already on.

errors.name: RuleNotEnabled
errors.msg: The rule is not on.

errors.name: RulePending
errors.msg: A sweep is in progress; finish it first.

errors.name: DelegateNotSet
errors.msg: The Book is not the delegate on the USDC account. Approve it first.

errors.name: DelegateStillSet
errors.msg: The delegate is still set. Revoke it in the same transaction.

errors.name: NotTopLevel
errors.msg: This instruction must be top-level, not a CPI.

errors.name: NoFinishSweep
errors.msg: No finish_sweep for this book and release follows in this transaction.

errors.name: MultipleBeginSweeps
errors.msg: Exactly one begin_sweep per transaction.

errors.name: InboundBelowMinimum
errors.msg: The net inflow is below the rule's minimum.

errors.name: SliceBelowMinimum
errors.msg: The slice would be below the $0.50 minimum.

errors.name: AllowanceTooLow
errors.msg: The delegate allowance is smaller than the slice. Re-approve.

errors.name: FloatTooLow
errors.msg: The Book's float cannot cover the tip and the receipt's rent. Top up.

errors.name: NoPending
errors.msg: There is no sweep pending on this book.

errors.name: PendingMismatch
errors.msg: The pending sweep does not match this instruction.

errors.name: CashMoved
errors.msg: The owner's cash moved between begin and finish. Nothing settles.

errors.name: PriceFeedWrong
errors.msg: The price account is not for this book's asset.

errors.name: PriceStale
errors.msg: The price is older than ten minutes. The sweep waits.

errors.name: PriceUncertain
errors.msg: The price's confidence band is wider than 1%.

errors.name: PriceInvalid
errors.msg: The price account could not be read.

errors.name: PriceNotFullyVerified
errors.msg: The price update is not fully verified.

errors.name: MultiplierInvalid
errors.msg: The mint's scaled-UI multiplier is outside anything a corporate action produces.

errors.name: ReceivedBelowMinimum
errors.msg: Less arrived than the price allows. Everything reverts.

errors.name: NotTheOwner
errors.msg: Only the owner may do this.

errors.name: WrongKind
errors.msg: This payout is not of the kind this instruction handles.

errors.name: EscrowBelowMinimum
errors.msg: The escrow holds less than the payer's own minimum.

errors.name: EscrowEmpty
errors.msg: The escrow is empty.

errors.name: RecipientRequired
errors.msg: A settle payout needs a recipient.

errors.name: BookRequired
errors.msg: A settle payout needs the recipient's Book.

errors.name: AssetMismatch
errors.msg: The recipient's Book is set to a different asset.

errors.name: NotTheRecipient
errors.msg: This payout is for someone else.

errors.name: ClaimKeyRequired
errors.msg: This payout needs its claim key.

errors.name: TooEarlyToCancel
errors.msg: A sponsored position may be cancelled after thirty days.

errors.name: WindowInvalid
errors.msg: The window is 7 or 30 days.

errors.name: TooEarlyToMeasure
errors.msg: This receipt is not old enough to measure yet.

errors.name: AlreadyMeasured
errors.msg: This window was already measured.

errors.name: WrongAta
errors.msg: That is not the associated token account this instruction expects.

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow.

errors.name: RuleStillOn
errors.msg: Turn the rule off before closing the book.

errors.name: WrongTokenProgram
errors.msg: The token program does not own that mint.

errors.name: FloatBelowRent
errors.msg: The float withdrawal would leave the Book below its rent.

errors.name: NothingToWithdraw
errors.msg: Nothing to withdraw.

errors.name: WatermarkNotAbove
errors.msg: The balance is not below the watermark; there is nothing to sync.

errors.name: GrantRecipientRequired
errors.msg: A grant needs a recipient.

errors.name: GrantScheduleInvalid
errors.msg: A grant's schedule must be within ten years.

errors.name: GrantNotSealed
errors.msg: The grant is not sealed; nothing can vest.

errors.name: GrantAlreadySealed
errors.msg: The grant was already sealed.

errors.name: NothingToVest
errors.msg: Nothing has vested yet.

errors.name: GrantNotActive
errors.msg: This grant is not active.

errors.name: GrantNotRevocable
errors.msg: This grant is not revocable.

errors.name: GrantStillOpen
errors.msg: A grant closes only when completed or revoked, with an empty escrow.

errors.name: GrantFloatTooLow
errors.msg: The grant's float cannot cover the tip and the receipt's rent. Top up.

types.name: Book
docs: THE BOOK — one per owner, at `["book", owner]`. It is also the token delegate address.
It holds the rule, the watermark and a float of lamports above its own rent. It never
holds a token: the owner's USDC and the owner's asset both sit in the owner's own
associated token accounts, and the only power the Book has over them is the delegate
allowance the owner approved and can revoke at any time without asking this program.

fields.name: asset
docs: The one asset the rule buys.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The pay-in mint. Mainnet: USDC, always. Devnet: whatever the test opened with.

fields.name: feed_raw
docs: Pyth feed id that prices one RAW token of the asset (e.g. Crypto.SPYX/USD). Zero = none.

fields.name: feed_adjusted
docs: Pyth feed id that prices one UI unit — one share-equivalent — so the scaled-UI
multiplier applies (e.g. Equity.US.SPY/USD). Zero = none.

fields.name: terms_version
docs: Eligibility attestation. >= 1 is required for an xStocks asset.

types.name: Grant
docs: A GRANT — stock bought now that vests on a schedule, from anyone to anyone.
`["grant", payer, grant_id]`. The stock sits in the grant's own escrow token account,
which the recipient can see and the payer cannot spend. Vesting is computed on RAW
units, so a dividend reinvested through the multiplier while the stock waits goes to
whoever the units vest to. A revoked grant returns only what had not vested; what had
accrued by then stays claimable by `vest`.

fields.name: total_raw
docs: Raw units in escrow at seal. Zero until sealed.

fields.name: release_cap_raw
docs: After a revoke: the most that may ever be released (what had accrued). u64::MAX otherwise.

fields.name: duration_secs
docs: Linear after the cliff; 0 = everything at the cliff.

fields.name: declared_usdc
docs: The exact-in USDC of the purchase, for the record.

fields.name: min_out_raw
docs: The least the escrow may hold at seal, from the payer's own quote.

types.name: Handle
docs: `["handle", slug]` → owner. What `/@<slug>` and `/pay/<slug>` resolve through.

types.name: HandleKind
docs: Who a handle names: a person with a rule, or an organisation that pays in stock.

types.name: Measurement
docs: One keep-rate measurement. `at == 0` means not yet measured.

fields.name: balance_raw
docs: The recipient's TOTAL raw balance of the asset at that instant. Raw, so a rebase
never reads as a sale.

types.name: Payout
docs: THE ESCROW — the only thing the program ever holds, and only while it is under a rule.
A Payout exists exactly while it is open. Release, claim and cancel all close it, so
there is no state field to drift from the truth: the account's existence is the state.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Settle: required. Sponsor: the address, or `Pubkey::default()` for "anyone with the key".

fields.name: claimant
docs: Sponsor with no address: the claim key's pubkey. Otherwise default.

fields.name: reason_hash
docs: sha256 of the reason, which travels as an SPL Memo in the same transaction.

fields.name: declared_usdc
docs: The exact-in USDC amount of the swap, in 6-decimal base units.

fields.name: min_out_raw
docs: The least the escrow may hold at release, from the payer's own quote.

fields.name: run_id
docs: The payroll run this payment belongs to, or zero. Copied onto the receipt.

types.name: Pending
docs: The state between `begin_sweep` and `finish_sweep`, inside one transaction.

fields.name: inbound
docs: The net inflow that triggered this sweep — the receipt's basis.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: The rate applied, after escalation.

fields.name: usdc_before
docs: The owner's USDC balance after the slice left. Must be unchanged at finish.

fields.name: ata_rent
docs: Lamports the keeper advanced to create the owner's asset account, or 0.

types.name: PriceStamp
docs: The Pyth price a sweep was verified against. `feed` all-zero means no stamp (intake).

types.name: Receipt
docs: THE RECEIPT — permanent, ~350 bytes, written in the same transaction as the conversion.
`["receipt", book, release_id]` for a sweep; `["receipt", payout, release_id]` for an
intake. A memory that lives only in a database is one that can be lost or be accused of
invention. This one can be opened by anyone, forever, and outlives the company.

fields.name: payer
docs: Sweep: default (attributed off chain from transfer history). Intake: the payer.

fields.name: submitter
docs: Who paid the fee and signed: the keeper, the payer, or the relayer.

fields.name: book
docs: The recipient's Book.

fields.name: run_id
docs: The payroll run this receipt belongs to, or zero.

fields.name: reason_hash
docs: Zero for a sweep.

fields.name: basis_usdc
docs: Sweep: the net inflow that triggered it. Intake: what was paid.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Sweep: the rate applied. Intake: 10_000.

fields.name: paid_usdc
docs: The USDC actually converted.

fields.name: amount_raw
docs: Raw token units received. Never a UI amount.

types.name: ReceiptKind
docs: What a receipt records. A stock was swept under a rule, paid, given to an empty wallet,
granted on a schedule, or vested from a grant.

types.name: Rule
docs: The rule and its watermark. Lives inline on the Book so there is exactly one copy.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: 1..=MAX_RATE_BPS. The share of a net inflow that becomes the asset.

fields.name: escalate_bps
docs: Added to `rate_bps` every ESCALATION_PERIOD after `enabled_unix`. 0 = none.

fields.name: floor_usdc
docs: Never sweep below this much USDC. 0 = no floor.

fields.name: cap_usdc
docs: The most of one inflow that is taxable. 0 = no cap.

fields.name: min_inbound
docs: An inflow smaller than this is ignored.

fields.name: tolerance_bps
docs: How far below the Pyth price (net of confidence) a fill may land. 50..=300.

fields.name: watermark
docs: The USDC balance the rule has already seen. Everything above it is new.
